memo: Filters menubar item was focused; pressed Down to ensure its menu is open+first item selected. NEXT: press 'l' (mnemonic for 'Light and Shadow') to open that submenu, then press 'v' for 'Vignette...' (or arrow-navigate if mnemonics don't take). Menu items are not exposed in the structured view, so rely on keyboard nav and watch for a new dialog window appearing in the view.
